predictability.label: medium
predictability.rule: between the high and low rules

asset_intensity.label: moderate
asset_intensity.rule: between the light and heavy rules

plan.summary: Medium predictability → DCF and comps weighted equally.

methods.name: Public Comps: Sector Peers
methods.reason: medium predictability: give the market check equal say

methods.name: Public Comps: Closest Match
methods.reason: peers closest on growth, margin, leverage, size and beta from anywhere in the sector: a check on the sector set

methods.name: Public Comps: Synthesized Firm
methods.reason: peers weighted to match the target's growth, discount rate, margin and leverage (the course's synthesized firm): a check on both sets

methods.name: DCF with Synergies
methods.reason: value to a buyer, synergies included: an offer price, not a standalone value

methods.name: Just Synergies
methods.reason: pre-announcement price plus the synergies: an offer price, not a standalone value

methods.name: LBO
methods.reason: what a financial buyer could pay given the cash flows and debt capacity

methods.name: Precedent Transactions
methods.reason: includes a control premium; not a standalone value

exit_multiple.label: Implied exit EV/EBITDA vs public comps
exit_multiple.note: 23.0x against a comps average of 11.3x (+105%): exit multiples are usually too high; check the terminal inputs

margin.note: EBITDA margin 6.1% vs peers' 14.0%: below normal, so part of a cost cut can last

headlines.answer: PPC is worth about $142.08 a share (range $86.10–$256.17), 401% above the $28.36 share price.
headlines.field: The methods are 123% apart: sector comps gives $88.02, the DCF $196.14, so the weights decide the answer.
headlines.spread: 80% of 2,000 simulated runs land between $112.89 and $396.04; more than 95% of runs are above the $28.36 price.
headlines.sensitivity: Each 0.5-point change in the discount rate moves value about $38.24 a share; the grid spans $116.37–$581.52.
headlines.comps: Sector peers imply $88.02 a share (range $59.30–$116.31); the 6 peers closest on fundamentals give $52.70, 40% less.
headlines.dcf: The DCF's $196.14 a share rests 72% on the terminal value.
